outline.subject: PEN America is a nonprofit organization that works to defend and celebrate free expression through the advancement of literature and human rights.

sections.title: PEN America
sections.covers: This section introduces the organization, its mission, membership, and primary areas of advocacy and programming.

sections.title: History
sections.covers: This section details the founding of the organization and its relationship to the broader PEN International network.

sections.title: Membership
sections.covers: This section outlines the membership requirements, the organization's founding charter, and its leadership structure.

sections.title: Literature
sections.covers: This section describes the organization's literary events, awards programs, and initiatives for incarcerated writers.

sections.title: Support to writers
sections.covers: This section explains the financial and professional support services provided to writers and literary professionals.

sections.title: Publications
sections.covers: This section lists the periodic publications produced by the organization.

sections.title: Free Expression
sections.covers: This section describes the organization's programs dedicated to defending free expression rights globally.

sections.title: Writers at Risk
sections.covers: This section outlines the advocacy efforts on behalf of individual writers and journalists facing persecution.

sections.title: Press Freedom
sections.covers: This section details the organization's monitoring of press freedom and its initiatives regarding media literacy.

sections.title: Campus Free Speech
sections.covers: This section covers the organization's work on campus free speech, online harassment resources, and the protection of artistic freedom.
